_comment: Hackathon demo library. Original, fictional messages written for the demo; NOT used for training (ml/tests checks this). The app copy lives in apps/mobile/assets/model/demo-samples.json and is regenerated by ml/training/train.py. 'example_of' is only a card label for presenters. The analysis pipeline never reads it.

samples.title: Prize + fee
samples.text: Mubarak ho! Apka mobile number Jeeto Inaam Scheme mein 5 lakh ke inaam ke liye muntakhib hua hai. Inaam hasil karne ke liye 2,500 rupay verification fee foran JazzCash karein: 0399-5550142. Sirf aaj tak!

samples.title: Wallet blocked
samples.text: JazzCash ALERT: Apka account 24 ghante mein band ho jayega kyunke biometric verification adhoori hai. Abhi verify karein: http://jazzcash-verify.example/login

samples.title: Bank OTP call
samples.text: Sir main Meezan Bank head office se bol raha hoon. Aap ka card update ho raha hai, abhi aap ko jo 6 digit code aya hai woh bata dein warna card block ho jayega.

samples.title: اکاؤنٹ بند
samples.text: محترم صارف! آپ کا بینک اکاؤنٹ بند ہونے والا ہے۔ اکاؤنٹ بحال کرنے کے لیے ابھی موصول ہونے والا او ٹی پی کوڈ اس نمبر 0399-5550178 پر بھیجیں۔

samples.title: Loan fee
samples.text: Mubarak ho! Aap ko 3 lakh ka bila sood qarza manzoor hua hai. Raqam aaj hi aap ke account mein, bas 1,500 processing fee is number pe Easypaisa karein: 0399-5550193

samples.title: Card phishing
samples.text: Dear Customer, your HBL debit card has been temporarily blocked due to suspicious activity. To unblock it, verify your card details and PIN at https://hbl-card-unblock.example within 2 hours.

samples.title: Bank debit alert
samples.text: HBL: Your A/C ****4821 has been debited by Rs. 3,450 on 09-Oct-2026 for a purchase at Imtiaz Store. Available balance Rs. 41,230. If this wasn't you, call the number on the back of your card.

samples.title: Real OTP message
samples.text: Your Meezan Bank OTP for an online purchase of Rs 2,999 is 581204. Do not share this code with anyone. Meezan Bank will never ask for your OTP.

samples.title: Ammi ko paise
samples.text: Ammi, aap ke Easypaisa pe 5,000 bhej diye hain. Dawai le lijiye ga, shaam ko call karta hoon.

samples.title: Wrong transfer?
samples.text: Assalam o alaikum, main ne ghalti se aap ke JazzCash pe 2,500 bhej diye hain. Please check kar ke wapis kar dein, mehrbani.
